intendedAction: Verify the newly implemented clearance review manifest preview tool is visible in the active MCP runtime after bridge reload and run one read-only live preview call.
notes: api_tool discovery found forgepilot_preview_operator_local_execution_clearance_review_manifest after bridge reload.
Live preview call returned previewOnly true and followOnTool forgepilot_create_operator_local_execution_clearance.
The preview returned an operator decision rule allowing Deny or Allow once and forbidding Always allow for the follow-on clearance action.
The preview returned artifact review manifest entries for target packet, execution request artifact, human approval artifact, and operator-local clearance output path.
The preview reported an existing local clearance file and stated the follow-on clearance action would mutate the existing file rather than create a new one.

The preview boundary reported no clearance creation, no clearance mutation, no clearance deletion, no files written, no approval consumption, no disable-switch clearing, no runner start contact, and no OpenCode start.
The stale historical tuple was not eligible for clearance popup invocation because approval and commit scope checks failed as expected.
observationSemantics: operator workflow trace is control-plane evidence, not model-performance evidence
